subject: Mythology
title: Hieroglyphs: The Sacred Writing
description: One-minute skill: Hieroglyphs: The Sacred Writing.

hook.text: For over a thousand years, no one on Earth could read Egyptian hieroglyphs. The knowledge was completely lost.

buildup.text: The Rosetta Stone, found in 1799, contained the same text in hieroglyphs, Demotic script, and Greek.

discovery.text: Jean-François Champollion cracked the code in 1822, realizing hieroglyphs were both pictures and sounds.

twist.text: Overnight, thousands of temple walls, tomb inscriptions, and papyri became readable for the first time in a millennium.

climax.text: Champollion's breakthrough unlocked an entire civilization's history, religion, and literature in one stroke.

punchline.text: One stone and one genius brought a dead language back to life.

quiz.question: How did Jean-François Champollion decode hieroglyphs?
options: He found a tomb with a translation guide painted on the wall
He used the Rosetta Stone, which had the same text in three scripts
He spent decades studying Egyptian temple paintings
